name: Clipboard
summary: Brown clipboard with a metal clip and a checklist of ticked boxes; anim check ticks the items off one by one.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the board rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size at s = 1 (about 660 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: check = ticks appear one by one; with none all ticks show

author: krakujs
